Customs

Гармонизированная система

An international standardized system for classifying traded goods, managed by the World Customs Organization (WCO), forming the basis for tariff schedules and customs regulations worldwide.

Quick answer: An international standardized system for classifying traded goods, managed by the World Customs Organization (WCO), forming the basis for tariff schedules and customs regulations worldwide.

Quick answer

Why it matters

Гармонизированная система matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Гармонизированная система?

In this glossary, Гармонизированная система refers to: An international standardized system for classifying traded goods, managed by the World Customs Organization (WCO), forming the basis for tariff schedules and customs regulations worldwide.

How is Гармонизированная система used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Каждый продукт, отправляемый за границу, должен классифицироваться по Гармонизированной системе для точного учета тарифов и соответствия."

Why does Гармонизированная система matter in logistics?

Гармонизированная система matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Гармонизированная система?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An international standardized system for classifying traded goods, managed by the World Customs Organization (WCO), forming the basis for tariff schedules and customs regulations worldwide.

Operational example

Every product shipped internationally must be classified under the Harmonized System for accurate tariff and compliance reporting.

Localized term

Гармонизированная система
